name: Excel with Chess Mercer Island Fall State Qualifier
note: Tournament Flyer Format: 5 Rounds. K-8 G/25;d5, NWSRS rated. Qualifier for the 2027 WA State Elementary Chess Championship. Sections: K-1 U700 2-3 U700 4-6 U700 K-8 Open U700 sections are ideal for players new to tournaments or casual players! Qualification: Players who score 3 points or more are qualified for the 2027 WSECC Championship Section. (Kindergarten players do not need to qualify.) Schedule: 10:30 AM to 4:00 PM, concludes with awards. Round 1 pairings posted at 10:30 AM & round 1 begins at 11 AM. No check in required. Awards: Awards will be presented around 4:00 PM. All students who score 3 points or more earn a trophy! Students who score 3.5 or more receive a placement trophy! Team trophies will be awarded. Medals for all first-time tournament players. Additional Info: Free lunch and concessions included for all students competing in the tournament. We encourage parents to drop of their child as we have staff on site who will supervise students between rounds! Chess sets and notation sheets will be provided. Refunds: All refunds subject to a $5 fee per transaction. There will be no refunds after 11/10/2026.
address: 8236 SE 24th St, Mercer Island, WA 98040, USA

name: 20th Annual (2027) Waypoint Foundation Scholastic Chess Tournament
note: Wait List / Cancellations: The registration demand for our tournament often exceeds our available capacity. We have therefore implemented a "Wait List" to allow hopeful participants the opportunity to take the place of registered individuals who are no longer able to attend the tournament. This functionality is contingent on 1) hopeful participants registering on the Wait List, 2) registered individuals cancelling their registrations if they will not be attending the tournament, and 3) Wait List individuals responding to invitations to participate within the time constraints listed in the invitation email. Cancellations on the day of the tournament or "no shows" effectively take away the opportunity for others to participate in the tournament and may be restricted from participation in future tournaments. Cancellations can be performed via the "request a refund" link in the registration confirmation email or by contacting the tournament director directly. Eligibility: Students, grades K-12 (public, private, home) in GRANT and ADAMS (WA) counties. Time: Check in promptly from 7:45-8:20am in the cafeteria. Round 1 starts at 8:30am. Round 2 and 3 will follow approximately 15 minutes after the end of the prior round. Round 4 will begin after lunch at approximately 12:00pm with Round 5 approximately 15 minutes after the end of Round 4. Playoff rounds to determine a sole winner, if needed, after Round 5. Awards: Cash prizes to be awarded with first prize of $500. Also, this is a regional qualifying tournament for state-level high school team and elementary individual tournaments. Format: 5-round, Swiss pairing, G/30 (1 hour maximum round time). Entry Fee: No entry fee! Participants must pre-register by 12:00pm, the day before the tournament. Lunch: Pizza lunch will be provided for youth participants, not spectators. Participants who would prefer to not eat pizza are welcome to bring a sack lunch. Prep Classes: Classes are held to explain tournament rules, chess notation, and such. Class participation is not required, although it is recommended for first-time participants. Parents are always welcome. Visit www.facebook.com/waypointfoundation for date/time/location information. These classes are typically (but not always) held the Thursday the week before the tournament and the Tuesday the week of the tournament at 6pm in the Parkway School library. Miscellaneous: Chess sets, clocks and notation sheets are provided. Registration: Participation is limited to the first 112 (updated!) registrations. Once this capacity has been reached in the online registration system, hopeful participants can register to be on the Wait List. There is no on-site registration. Information: Visit www.waypointfoundation.org for tournament rules and other information. Stay up to date on our Facebook page at www.facebook.com/waypointfoundation. Legal Notes: This event is not sponsored or endorsed by any school district, nor does any school district assume any liability for the tournament. In consideration of the privilege to distribute materials pertaining to this tournament, participating school districts will be held harmless from any cause of action filed in any court or administrative tribunal arising out of the distribution of these materials, including costs, attorney’s fees, and judgements or awards. Rules of Participation:This event is held at the facilities of the Ephrata School District. It is expected that participants and spectators treat these facilities with a high degree of appreciation to the school district for making the facilities available for the chess tournament. Any person on the premises found to vandalizing the property or otherwise not treating the facilities with respect will be asked to leave immediately. If these persons are tournament participants, they will forfeit any tournament prizes. We spend a lot of time preparing for and executing this chess tournament, and everyones participating in caring for the facilities is much appreciated.
